terra.problem: “Always” overstates the sources, and “go against what is right” adds an idea not stated in them. “Contrary,” “cross others,” and “twisted, difficult attitude” may also be unclear to a 10-year-old.
The meaning does not adequately cover perversity as evil or corrupt behavior, plans, or words, as in the verses about devising perversity, uttering perversities, and a city full of perversity.
